svg.text: 325★ Renderer library. Gouraud, textures, depth buffer. No UI, no SD, no applet system.
Lesson: adopt their Gouraud approach. Gap: they have no product layer.
8★ P4-specific engine. Scene graph, component architecture. Demo only, no file I/O.
Lesson: scene graph is right long-term. Gap: no workflow, no user-facing product.
Proof-of-concept renders on P4. No code released, no interaction, no file loading.
Gap: zero polish. We are the only project that ships a usable tool.
Only project with: shell UI, file browser, SD pipeline, joystick, touch, back navigation.
First and only standalone 3D viewer firmware for M5Stack Tab5.
